### `AeSegment`

Both sides of a segment in After Effects' model: the start key's outgoing speed/influence and
the end key's incoming ones (spec 2 §2.2.4).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outSpeed` | `NumberOrVector` | yes | Outgoing speed at the start key, units per second (one number or one per dimension). |
| `outInfluence` | number | yes | Outgoing influence at the start key, percent 0.1–100. |
| `inSpeed` | `NumberOrVector` | yes | Incoming speed at the end key. |
| `inInfluence` | number | yes | Incoming influence at the end key, percent 0.1–100. |

Unknown fields are rejected (`doc.unknown_field`).
